harness_contract.intent: Demonstrate the real mumei-agent evidence-check-adapter route against Core's declared adapter-manifest representation diagnostic. The minimal Core fixture selects as a valid representation with acceptance not evaluated; a wrong-schema manifest fails closed with no selection. Declared command/stdin metadata stays inert and no adapter execution, Evidence acceptance or grade promotion is claimed.
artifact_contracts: Step 1 derives a wrong-schema negative manifest from Core's checked-in minimal adapter-manifest fixture without changing the fixture.

Step 2 runs evidence-check-adapter on the fixture and asserts its observed valid representation-only report, exact performed/unperformed checks, inert absent command/stdin declarations, and selected result.
Step 3 runs the route on the wrong-schema manifest and asserts the observed nonzero Core exit, no selected result, and no diagnostic claim fields.

name: Declared Adapter Manifest Check (evidence-check-adapter)
description: C11 representation-only adapter-manifest check. The route selects only when Core's diagnostic matches the local manifest representation. Acceptance stays not_evaluated; the route does not execute adapter commands, enforce host policy or resources, accept Evidence, or promote a grade.

narrative.before: A Core adapter-manifest diagnostic has not yet been checked.
narrative.after: Manifest representation only; no Evidence-acceptance/grade-promotion or code-correctness proof.
narrative.moment: Invalid schema fails closed; adapter execution is not performed.
intro: Step 2: Check Core's valid manifest representation.
Step 3: Fail closed on the wrong schema.
Acceptance not evaluated; adapter commands are not run.
No Evidence acceptance or grade-promotion claim.

result_message: Result: Manifest representation; invalid input fails closed.

intent_fidelity.source_intent: Show that the agent selects Core's exact adapter-manifest representation diagnostic when the local manifest matches, while a malformed schema produces no selection. Declared argv/stdin and verdict markers are representation metadata, not execution or truth claims.
success_criteria: valid_report.json has schema_version == 'mumei.evidence-check-adapter-report/v1', representation == 'valid', acceptance == 'not_evaluated', attempt_argv == 'absent', attempt_stdin == 'absent', verdict_marker_count == 0, exact declared_field_meaning and checks lists, a candidate, and a selected_result
invalid_report.json has normalized.exit_code == 1, no candidate, no selected_result, and none of the diagnostic fields

steps.name: Prepare a wrong-schema negative manifest
steps.command: python3 -c "import json; p='{root_dir}/scenarios/evidence_check_adapter/fixtures/adapter_manifest_minimal.json'; d=json.load(open(p)); d['schema_version']='mumei.not-verifier-adapter/v1'; json.dump(d,open('{output_dir}/invalid_manifest.json','w')); print('wrong-schema manifest derived from Core minimal fixture')"
steps.artifact_contract: invalid_manifest.json changes only the schema_version of the checked-in Core minimal adapter fixture.
steps.verifier_gate: The negative input is derived locally and does not modify the Core fixture.

steps.name: Select the valid Core adapter representation diagnostic
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent evidence-check-adapter --core {mumei_bin} --manifest {root_dir}/scenarios/evidence_check_adapter/fixtures/adapter_manifest_minimal.json --output {output_dir}/valid_report.json > {output_dir}/valid.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/valid_report.json; cat {output_dir}/valid.log; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/valid_report.json')); assert r['schema_version']=='mumei.evidence-check-adapter-report/v1', r; assert r['manifest_schema_version']=='mumei.verifier-adapter/v1', r; assert r['representation']=='valid', r; assert r['acceptance']=='not_evaluated', r; assert r['attempt_argv']=='absent', r; assert r['attempt_stdin']=='absent', r; assert r['verdict_marker_count']==0, r; assert r['declared_field_meaning']=={'attempt_argv':'inert_without_host_opt_in','attempt_stdin':'inert_without_host_opt_in','verdict_markers':'adapter_self_report_vocabulary','max_memory_mb':'declared_ceiling_not_enforced_by_core'}, r; assert r['checks_performed']==['representation_gate','manifest_consistency'], r; assert r['checks_not_performed']==['adapter_execution','command_safety','stdin_semantics','reported_outcome_truth','resource_enforcement','producer_authenticity','host_policy','grade_promotion'], r; assert r['normalized']['exit_code']==0, r; assert r['sequence'].get('selected_result') is not None, r; assert r['candidate']['schema_version']=='mumei.verifier-evidence-candidate/v1', r; print('valid representation selected; acceptance not_evaluated; no adapter execution or grade promotion')"
steps.artifact_contract: valid_report.json matches Core's exact representation-only diagnostic and local manifest: acceptance is not_evaluated, command/stdin are absent, and selection carries no adapter-execution, Evidence-acceptance or grade-promotion claim.
steps.verifier_gate: The report has the observed exact performed/unperformed checks, a matching candidate and selected result.

steps.name: Fail closed on a wrong-schema manifest
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent evidence-check-adapter --core {mumei_bin} --manifest {output_dir}/invalid_manifest.json --output {output_dir}/invalid_report.json > {output_dir}/invalid.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/invalid_report.json; cat {output_dir}/invalid.log; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/invalid_report.json')); assert r['schema_version']=='mumei.evidence-check-adapter-report/v1', r; assert r['normalized']['exit_code']==1, r; assert r['normalized']['stdout']['size_bytes']==0, r; assert r['sequence'].get('selected_result') is None, r; assert 'candidate' not in r, r; assert all(k not in r for k in ('manifest_schema_version','representation','acceptance','attempt_argv','attempt_stdin','verdict_marker_count','declared_field_meaning','checks_performed','checks_not_performed')), r; print('wrong-schema manifest rejected; no diagnostic selection')"
steps.artifact_contract: invalid_report.json reports Core exit code 1 and no selected result, candidate or diagnostic fields.
steps.verifier_gate: A nonzero Core check on the wrong-schema manifest fails closed.
